text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Mom and Dad. I'm sorry I haven't 
written in a while. A lot happened with 
City-san..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"I worked up my courage and asked her 
about it. And... I realized that even 
someone as flawless as City-san has things 
she worries about."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"I told City-san. That because it was my 
dream to be like her, I was able to grit 
my teeth and hold on."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"I told her what I needed to say! I'm sure 
City-san will cheer up and run again. I'm 
gonna do my best too!"
